name: Turkey Chilli with Sweet Potato
method: Brown the turkey mince with the chopped onion and peppers in the oil. Stir in the tomato puree, cumin, smoked paprika and a pinch of chilli flakes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, kidney beans and diced sweet potato with 100 ml water, then simmer for 25 minutes until the potato is soft and the chilli is thick.
